verdict.rationale: Railway documents two background-autonomy capabilities. The built-in Railway Agent can automatically investigate failed deployments and open fix PRs. Cloud agents keep running coding agents on remote machines after you disconnect, so work continues unattended. There is no documented way for a user to define their own triggers or recurring schedules. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation/trigger setup, recurring scheduled runs (e.g. cron), and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: When a deployment fails, the agent can automatically investigate.
Identify the cause of a failed deployment and open a pull request against your repository with a proposed fix.
Your files stay on the agent's disk, and the machine stays running when you disconnect.
Railway CA gives you one place to browse your machines, start sessions, and return to work that's still running.
